## installer-v0.1.1: point the updater at the public releases repo

The one change that matters to anyone running v0.1.0. That build polls
defessler/game-rom-manager, which is private, so the API answers 404 and
the wizard reports "no updates" forever rather than reporting a broken
lookup. This build polls defessler/Emulatarr-releases instead.

v0.1.0 cannot reach this release on its own for exactly that reason. The
fix ships inside the thing it cannot fetch, so v0.1.0 has to be replaced
by hand once. Every build from here updates itself normally.

Also: the exe's CompanyName now reads Doug Fessler rather than GitHub,
Inc., which is what electron-builder falls back to when package.json names
no author.

---

**Download:** `emulatarr-installer-win-unpacked.zip` — extract anywhere on your Windows machine and run `Emulatarr Installer.exe`. Nothing is installed locally; the wizard drives your NAS over SSH.

Existing installs update in place: the wizard polls GitHub Releases, shows a **New version** banner, and applies the update on **Restart & install**. Saved profiles in `%APPDATA%\emulatarr-installer\` survive updates.

Prefer to skip the wizard? The wizard uploads exactly `nas/scripts/`, so copying that folder to your NAS and running `setup.sh` is a supported route — see [`QUICKSTART.md`](https://github.com/defessler/Emulatarr-releases/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md).
